editorial:
Imagine being a pampered house dog in sunny California and suddenly waking up in the freezing snow of the Yukon. That is exactly what happens to Buck, a sweet dog with a huge heart who gets thrown into the middle of the 1890s Gold Rush. You will feel for him as he goes from sleeping on a couch to pulling heavy mail sleds across the ice. The movie has a really warm, cozy vibe despite the cold setting, and it focuses on the special bond between humans and animals. It is a classic fish-out-of-water story that makes you root for the underdog from the very first scene.

The CGI used for Buck is pretty impressive and makes his emotions feel real, though some parts might feel a bit too digital for you. The pacing is steady and the scenery is breathtaking, making it a great pick for a family movie night. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all those snowy mountains in detail. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move. It is a heartfelt ride that anyone who loves dogs will enjoy.
endingExplained: At the end, Buck meets a pack of wild wolves and realizes he belongs with them. After his owner John dies, Buck decides to leave his old life behind and join the wild pack as their leader. He finally finds his true home and becomes the master of his own destiny. It is a happy ending because Buck gets to be free and live naturally in the wild with his new family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dogs and grand adventures.
